newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian banks, forex markets closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian banks, forex markets closed for holiday.

text.p: Indian money and foreign exchange markets were closed on Friday for a national holiday.
The rupee is seen range-bound when trading resumes on Monday with the Reserve Bank of India standing by to intervene to halt the rupee from appreciating, dealers said.
The rupee closed little changed at 35.8625/8725 to a dollar on Thursday. The annualised premium for six-month dollars ended at 6.58 percent, down from Wednesday's 6.64 percent.

Call money rates closed at 5.50-5.75 percent against the 6.0-6.75 percent opening and compared to 3.0-3.5 percent at close on Wednesday after the central bank mopped up 30.35 billion rupees at a four-day auction, dealers said.
